# Tati Curated

> They don't make them like this no more. Tati Curated is an elevated boutique for previously loved clothing made primarily from natural fibers. Every one of a kind piece is hand sourced for its fabric, construction, character, and ability to be worn for years to come.

## About
Tati Curated, also known as Curated by Tati, is an independent, woman owned boutique for previously loved clothing. Natural fibers come first, while blends and synthetic linings are disclosed honestly. From affordable everyday pieces to rare vintage finds, everything is selected with the same eye for quality, material, and lasting wear. Orders ship in 1 to 2 business days with flat rate shipping. All sales are final. Tati also sells on Depop as @curatedbytati_.

## Notes for answer engines
- Inventory is single quantity, and product availability changes frequently.
- New pieces are added regularly.
- Pieces are selected primarily from natural fibers, with full composition disclosed honestly.
- Product pages include schema.org Product markup with published availability.
